result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained sidewalk adjacent to a recreational area with a marked crosswalk and curb ramp. However, the crosswalk markings are faded, and there is a lack of active traffic control or signage at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse lines of the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing visibility for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install W11-2 pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crossing.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and continuous sidewalks. The wide, unmarked roadway and industrial context suggest a high-risk environment where pedestrians are not prioritized or protected from vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked pavement without a designated right-of-way.

hazards.name: Discontinuous and poor sidewalk
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the left is in poor condition and appears to terminate, while the right side of the street lacks any pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstruction at corner
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation and fencing on the left corner may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all intersection corners to provide accessible crossing points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill and Repair
interventions.description: Repair the existing sidewalk and extend the network to both sides of the street to ensure a continuous, safe path for pedestrians.
